caption: The drawing features a single bird perched on a short, curved branch. The bird's body is primarily green with shades of olive and yellow on its underside and around its head, while its wings and tail are darker, almost black. There are faint brown and yellow stripes visible on its lower belly and some hints of red on the top of its head just above the beak. The branch is brown and knobby, and it emerges from a large, irregularly shaped platform that appears to resemble a rough-textured shell or piece of layered rock, rendered in shades of brown, grey, and muted green. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or cream color, providing no detail or additional elements. There is a small printed text at the bottom right corner that reads "JOHN T. BOWEN."
title: Robin (German?)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
